newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed ahead of auction.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed ahead of auction.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were narrowly mixed as bankers remained uncertain over the short-term outlook of the spot rates, traders said.
"Everything will be clearer after the auction," one trader said.
The weekly Treasury bill auction is scheduled at 1.00 p.m. (0500 GMT). Rates for the three-month, six-month and one-year Treasury bills are determined during the auction.
Bankers were jittery over the short-dated instruments for fear the Central Bank might raise its benchmark rates at the next sign of speculation over the peso.
